How it works

  1. 1

    Watch the demo

    See a native signer demonstrate the sign with a written description.

  2. 2

    Sign on your webcam

    Your camera runs MediaPipe Hands locally — no frames are uploaded.

  3. 3

    Get instant feedback

    The AI tells you exactly which finger is wrong and what to fix.

  4. 4

    Track your progress

    Spaced repetition surfaces signs you're forgetting before they fade.

🔒 Your privacy is the default

Webcam frames and hand landmarks are processed entirely in your browser using WebAssembly. They are never transmitted to any server. The "🔒 On-device" badge is visible whenever your camera is active.
